rule.description: Statement regions that the analysed sources prove the interpreter never executes under any supported run of this code: whole if-suites guarded by conditions that resolve statically to a constant at import time (module-level literal constants, including constants imported from other modules, combined with and/or/not and literal comparisons), the else arms of guard conditions resolving statically to True, Pylint-native unreachable tails after return/raise/break/continue, and whole modules whose every import site itself lies inside such a never-executed region (only-dead-imports).

checks.description: Detect whole if-suites whose guard condition resolves statically to False, so the suite can never execute.
checks.why_this_is_the_smell: The suite is retained obsolete implementation: under the configuration the sources ship (Python 3 lesson code with legacy switches pinned off), no supported run can reach it.

matches.evidence: Module-level suite guarded by PYTHON2_AUDIO_PROTOCOLS = False; the guard imports stringify helpers that no supported interpreter uses.
Suite guarded by (PYTHON2_AUDIO_PROTOCOLS and sys.version_info[0] == 2) re-homes the legacy wave/chunk readers behind package-root aliases; False and True = False in any order.
Module-level suite guarded by (PYTHON2_AUDIO_PROTOCOLS and sys.version_info[0] == 2) binds a legacy stream wrapper that the effect's supported path never reads.
Inside echo_function, a branch guarded by (PYTHON2_AUDIO_PROTOCOLS or LEGACY_DECODER_CHAINS) would return a legacy repr instead of the mock effect string; both disjuncts are False.
Package-level suite guarded by (PYTHON2_AUDIO_PROTOCOLS and sys.version_info[:2] == (2, 7)) aliases legacy repr/stream helpers for the effects subpackage.
Package-level suite guarded by (LEGACY_DECODER_CHAINS and sys.version_info[0] < 3) registers a READER_ALIASES table that no supported interpreter ever builds.
Inside wav_read, the (not MODERN_BUFFER_API) branch would open the lesson file through the legacy array-based reader; MODERN_BUFFER_API is True.

checks.description: Detect else arms of guard conditions that resolve statically to True, so the else arm can never execute.
checks.detected_relation: never-executed else arm -> import-time constant guard
checks.why_this_is_the_smell: The arm preserves an obsolete buffer-model path that the shipped configuration can no longer select.

matches.evidence: The else arm of (MODERN_BUFFER_API or sys.version_info[:2] >= (3, 6)) keeps the array-buffer decode model alive; on every supported interpreter the disjunction is True.

checks.description: Pylint-native unreachable (W0101) detects statement tails after a terminal statement inside a function body.
checks.why_this_is_the_smell: The retained tail is obsolete implementation kept after the reader was simplified to a mock; it can no longer execute through any input.

matches.evidence: aif_read returns its mock string and then keeps a legacy form-chunk decoding tail whose imports and control flow can never be reached.

checks.description: Detect whole modules whose every import site lies inside a region already proven never-executed, so the module itself can never be loaded in any supported run.
checks.detected_relation: unreachable module -> only never-executed import sites
checks.why_this_is_the_smell: The module is an obsolete artifact: it exists only to serve retained legacy branches, so it lengthens maintenance without any possible run-time role.

matches.evidence: Every import site for _codecs_py2 lies inside a constant-false guard suite, a never-executed else arm, or a post-terminal tail across seven package files; no live import exists.

excluded.reason: Its `if __name__ == '__main__':` diagnostic block is an idiomatic entry guard whose condition is not an import-time constant in the rule's sense; the rule leaves it in place and the module is out of the case's injected scope.

These modules have no internal importers in the pinned clean tree, but lack of callers alone does not establish obsolescence; the only-dead-imports predicate keys on import sites inside never-executed regions, not on call-graph popularity, so the clean tree is reported clean.
Lesson prose, exercises, and the pytest suite are outside the analyzed production boundary; the checker evaluates src/modules only.
